items.description: Replacement of stolen household contents (clothing, personal effects and everyday jewellery)
items.rationale: The policy covers forcible removal of insured property (2.6) and includes ordinary clothing and everyday jewellery as movable property of the household (4.2.6, 4.4.5, 4.4.6). The description and police reference confirm forced entry. The jewellery is described as modest and everyday, so the EUR 1,000 per-article sub-limit for high-value items (4.4.2) does not apply; these are indemnified in full within the sum insured. Reference cases show ordinary clothing and modest jewellery are paid at ordinary replacement value, not capped. No evidence of betterment or upgrades. VAT is included. No deductible is specified, so none is applied.

items.description: Emergency repair and re-securing of the forced entry door
items.rationale: The policy covers immediate securing and provisional protection after a break-in (5.2.2), including temporary boarding and restoring the closure element to a lockable state. The photo shows a boarded door and tools, matching the invoice. Indemnity is capped at EUR 1,000 per event for this head (5.2.2). Reference cases for similar emergency repairs (e.g., glass replacement, door securing) show typical indemnity for such work is well below the cap. VAT is included.
